lines.zh: 我挂在叶背，风一吹就晃。
lines.en: I hang under a leaf and sway with the wind.

lines.zh: 我动不了，只能等风带我摇。
lines.en: I cannot move. The wind rocks me instead.

lines.zh: 我在壳里翻了个身，壳跟着摆。
lines.en: I turn inside my case and it swings.
The leaf stalk bends a little under me.

lines.zh: 雨打过来，我转了个方向。
lines.en: Rain strikes and I turn on my thread.

lines.zh: 我在叶脉边上慢慢打转。
lines.en: I rotate slowly by the leaf's vein.

lines.zh: 我挂在叶背，丝缠着叶脉。
lines.en: I hang beneath the leaf, silk wound on its vein.
It is cramped in here; I shift.

lines.zh: 我顺着叶尖的方向倾过去。
lines.en: I lean toward the leaf tip.

lines.zh: 一只蚂蚁爬过叶子，我晃了。
lines.en: An ant crosses the leaf and I swing.
My silk holds. I will not fall.

lines.zh: 我在壳里听见外面的鸟。
lines.en: Inside the case I hear birds outside.
I swing back to my old angle.

lines.zh: 叶子被风翻过来，我露了出来。
lines.en: The wind turns the leaf and exposes me.
I hurriedly withdraw under it.

lines.zh: 这一阵风过去，我稳住了。
lines.en: The gust passes and I settle.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一片枯叶。
lines.en: I hold still as a dead leaf.

lines.zh: 我的壳是黄绿色的，带细纹。
lines.en: My case is yellow-green with fine lines.
Things are changing in here. I can feel it.
I count the times the sun has come.

lines.zh: 有露水在我壳上聚成一颗。
lines.en: Dew gathers in a bead on my case.

lines.zh: 我听着树汁在叶脉里走。
lines.en: I hear sap moving in the veins.

lines.zh: 我的旧皮已经脱在下面了。
lines.en: My old skin lies shed below me.

lines.zh: 我试着动了动还软的部分。
lines.en: I test the parts of me still soft.
Not quite there yet.

lines.zh: 林子里的光从绿变成金。
lines.en: The light in the wood turns from green to gold.

lines.zh: 安静下来，翅膀在里面折着。
lines.en: All quiet, wings folded inside.

lines.zh: 这层壳很快就不需要了。
lines.en: Soon this case will not be needed.

lines.zh: 你凑近了看，我晃了一下。
lines.en: You lean in close and I swing once.

lines.zh: 我只是一枚挂在叶下的蛹。
lines.en: I am only a chrysalis under a leaf.

lines.zh: 你伸手，我没有躲的本事。
lines.en: You reach out; I have no way to dodge.

lines.zh: 你碰了碰叶柄，我摆得更厉害。
lines.en: You touch the stalk and I swing harder.
You pull back and I settle.
If you must look, look through the case.
I must stay here a while yet.

lines.zh: 你身上的影子落在我壳上。
lines.en: Your shadow falls across my case.
It blocks some sun. That is not bad.
You leave, and the light returns.
My case is pressed in.
I curl tight inside.
The silk has loosened a little.
I swing violently.
A fine split opens in the case.
The pain keeps me still.
Something seeps out.
I am going to fall.
I catch with the silk that remains.
I am still alive.
I do not eat. I am changing.
You hold a leaf up to me.
Through the case I smell the sap.
But I have no mouth now.
Save that for later.
You hold it out; I never move.
I am no longer a larva.
A jungle chrysalis on a leaf's back.
When I emerge, perhaps.
Then I will look for flowers, not leaves.

lines.zh: 你碰到叶子，我跟着一震。
lines.en: You knock the leaf and I jolt with it.

lines.zh: 我的丝拉紧了一下，没断。
lines.en: My silk pulls taut. It holds.
I swing back into place.
That leaves my case ringing.
Do not touch the stalk again.
You step back and the wind governs me again.
I turn twice in the air.
The leaf shivers with me.
Close, but I did not fall.
I need a moment of quiet.
I have no such business now.
I am a chrysalis, waiting to change.

lines.zh: 隔壁叶上还有一枚，和我一样。
lines.en: There is another on the next leaf, like me.
We hang on either side of a vein.
Neither looks at the other.

lines.zh: 等我羽化，也许会遇见它。
lines.en: When I emerge, perhaps I will meet it.

lines.zh: 那时候我是黄的，翅膀很大。
lines.en: Then I will be yellow, with wide wings.
It is too early to speak of it.
So I go on waiting.
The case grows tighter.
I can pick nothing up.

lines.zh: 东西落在我下面的叶上。
lines.en: Something falls on the leaf below me.
I cannot see it. I can only hear.
Something rolls across the leaf.
It has stopped short.
The wind moves it on again.
Very near my thread.

lines.zh: 要是撞上来，我会晃很久。
lines.en: If it strikes, I will swing a long while.

lines.zh: 落下去的东西，我够不着。
lines.en: It fell; I can't reach it.
I hear it land.
A shadow moves on the leaf.
I have no means to answer it.
I can only pretend to be a leaf.
I hang under a leaf like a fruit.
It stops beside me.

lines.zh: 我连呼吸都放轻了，怕破了蛹壳。
lines.en: I barely breathe, afraid to split the chrysalis.
It extends something.
It did not touch me.
That thing has gone.

lines.zh: 这片叶子暂时还是安全的。
lines.en: This leaf is safe for now.
I can only listen to it.
Its steps are on the leaf.
It circles my leaf.
Each turn tightens me.
It begins to climb.
The stalk moves. I know.
On a leaf's underside, like a dried fruit.
It reaches the underside.
The light is blocked.
It withdraws at last.

lines.zh: 我只能摆动，让它抓不稳。
lines.en: I can only swing, to keep it from gripping.
I swing and strike its hand.
The case is hard and knocks audibly.
It pulls its hand back.
My thread stretches long.
The stalk breaks under me.
I fall with it.

lines.zh: 落在下面的灌木上，没碎。
lines.en: I land in the shrub below, unbroken.
Now I am harder to find.
I wait quietly for it to be over.

lines.zh: 我在叶背结好了最后一层丝。
lines.en: I finish the last layer of silk under a leaf.
My old skin hangs beside me.

lines.zh: 我把自己固定住，不再动。
lines.en: I fix myself in place and stop moving.
The jungle light is green.
I hear water far away.
Leaves turn in the wind.
I chose one thick enough.
Rain does not pierce the case.
I begin to change.

lines.zh: 外面的事暂时与我无关。
lines.en: The outside does not concern me for now.

lines.zh: 热气让我的壳发软，我蜷得更紧。
lines.en: The heat softens my case and I curl tighter.

lines.zh: 我从叶子上掉下去，壳磕在石头上。
lines.en: I drop from the leaf and my case strikes stone.

lines.zh: 雨水灌进壳缝，我快要闷死。
lines.en: Rainwater seeps in and I am close to suffocating.

lines.zh: 气浪把叶子和我也掀开了。
lines.en: The blast tears the leaf away with me on it.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦过我的壳，留下一道沟。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my case and leaves a groove.

lines.zh: 奇怪的光透进壳里，我全身发麻。
lines.en: Strange light pierces the case and I go numb.
Half-changed, and I have no strength left.

lines.zh: 雷劈在树上，我整个壳都在震。
lines.en: Lightning hits the tree and my whole case shakes.

lines.zh: 叶子消失了，我在黑里飘。
lines.en: The leaf vanishes and I drift in black.
